previous_statement: For the constants above and every 0 < delta <= delta_R, the numerical inequality 1 <= sqrt(delta)*[2L+2(2+4delta)B] is impossible: delta <= 2^(-16) gives 2+4delta < 3, while delta <= 1/(4H^2) gives sqrt(delta)*H <= 1/2, so its right side is strictly less than sqrt(delta)*(2L+6B) = sqrt(delta)*H <= 1/2. Thus no putative configuration exists for this delta_R.
